verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ עַד־ יְ֭הוָה תִּשְׁכָּחֵ֣נִי אָ֣נָה נֶ֑צַח עַד־ אָ֓נָה׀ תַּסְתִּ֖יר אֶת־ פָּנֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ‘aḏ- Yah·weh tiš·kā·ḥê·nî ’ā·nāh ne·ṣaḥ ‘aḏ- ’ā·nāh tas·tîr ’eṯ- pā·ne·ḵā mim·men·nî
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David How long O LORD Will You forget me forever How long . . . will You hide - Your face from me

verses.original: עַד־ אָ֨נָה אָשִׁ֪ית עֵצ֡וֹת בְּנַפְשִׁ֗י יָג֣וֹן בִּלְבָבִ֣י יוֹמָ֑ם עַד־ אָ֓נָה׀ אֹיְבִ֣י יָר֖וּם עָלָֽי׃
verses.literal: How long . . . must I wrestle . . . in my soul with sorrow in my heart each day How long . . . will my enemy dominate me

verses.original: הַבִּ֣יטָֽה עֲ֭נֵנִי יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י הָאִ֥ירָה עֵ֝ינַ֗י פֶּן־ אִישַׁ֥ן הַמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.literal: Consider me [and] respond O LORD my God Give light to my eyes lest I sleep in death

verses.original: פֶּן־ אֹיְבִ֣י יֹאמַ֣ר יְכָלְתִּ֑יו צָרַ֥י יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ כִּ֣י אֶמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: pen- ’ō·yə·ḇî yō·mar yə·ḵā·lə·tîw ṣā·ray yā·ḡî·lū kî ’em·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: lest my enemy say I have overcome him and my foes rejoice when I fall

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ בָטַחְתִּי֮ בְּחַסְדְּךָ֣ לִבִּ֗י יָ֤גֵ֥ל בִּֽישׁוּעָ֫תֶ֥ךָ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ḇā·ṭaḥ·tî bə·ḥas·də·ḵā lib·bî yā·ḡêl bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion my heart will rejoice in Your salvation
I will sing to the LORD for He has been good to me
